observation: Read all3045characters. An aspirational SDG opening leads to five problem-labelled steps. Problem1constructs separate multilayer goal networks from Pearson correlations and reports contrasting positive SDG8/negative SDG17relations in WLD. Problem2adds feedback/time effects to priority evaluation across ten regions;SDG4is recommended in five regions,and projected attainability differs by goal and region. Problem3changes achieved-goal influence to one-way links and recomputes priorities:implementing SDG4in WLD shifts the preferred next goal toSDG8;technology/digitalization is proposed as an added goal with selected positive links. Problem4introduces event perturbations,contrasts WLD/local-war prioritySDG1withSDG17and compares seven event impacts,calling natural disasters greatest for the examined SDG9case. Problem5describes a business-goal transfer example and broader intended use. The closing claims robustness,stability and interpretability without reporting a sensitivity range or independent external validation in this delivered summary. The argument repeatedly maps a concrete network change to a revised action,while its global wording exceeds the specific illustrated cases. All numbers and claims are retained as author reports;no formula or figure interpretation performed.
